note: Mr Ping's famous noodle soup

dish.make_ahead: Stock up to 3 days ahead, or freeze

steps.text: Put the frames in a pot with the ginger, garlic and spring onions and cover with the water.
Simmer gently for 3 hours, skimming now and then, then strain. Poach the chicken thighs in the stock for the last 15 minutes.
Season the stock with soy and white pepper and shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles and bok choy briefly, then pour the hot stock over them with the chicken. The secret is there isn't one.

note: the busy village below the Jade Palace

dish.n: Valley of Peace kung pao chicken

steps.text: Rinse the jasmine rice, then simmer covered in 450ml water on low for 15 minutes and rest off the heat.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the 1 tbsp cornflour. Mix the remaining 3 tbsp soy, the black vinegar, sugar, extra cornflour and 60ml water for the sauce.
Slice the garlic, grate the ginger and cut the spring onions into 3cm lengths.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot, stir-fry the dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds, then add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in the peanuts and serve with the rice.

note: Whole snapper rubbed with Cajun spice, hush puppies, cabbage slaw

steps.text: Score the snapper and rub with Cajun seasoning and butter.
Roast at 200C.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg into a hush puppy batter.
Fry spoonfuls until golden.
Shred the cabbage and mix with mayonnaise for slaw.
Serve the fish with lemon, hush puppies and slaw.
Stuff the fish with lemon slices, sliced ginger and the coriander.
Dot with butter and wrap well in foil.
Cook over hot coals or a hot grill, turning once.
Rest briefly before opening the parcel.

note: Crispy chicken thigh tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame

steps.text: Cut the chicken and toss in cornflour.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the chicken in batches until crisp.
Warm the honey with the soy sauce until bubbling and toss the chicken through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.

note: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with crackling, green apples and kūmara

dish.make_ahead: Gravy fresh

steps.text: Score the pork and rub with salt, then leave uncovered in the fridge, which is the resting time.
Roast at 230C.
Reduce to 170C and roast on a bed of apple and onion, adding the kumara for the last hour.
Make gravy with the flour, water and pan juices.

note: Crisp-skinned duck breast with orange honey sauce and potatoes

dish.n: Chef Didier's duck with orange sauce
dish.make_ahead: Serve straight away

steps.text: Score the duck skin and season.
Place skin-side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat to render the fat.
Flip and roast at 200C.
Rest the duck.
Fry the par-boiled potatoes in some of the duck fat until crisp.
Pour off the rest of the fat, add orange juice, honey, orange liqueur and stock and reduce until glossy.
Whisk in the butter.
Steam the green beans and serve alongside.

note: Franks in steamed buns with onion tomato sauce, spicy mustard, warm sauerkraut

steps.text: Soften the sliced onions in oil.
Add the tomato paste and a splash of water and cook down.
Simmer the franks in water.
Warm the sauerkraut and steam the buns.
Fill the buns with franks, mustard, sauerkraut and onions.

note: Crispy pork tossed in pineapple and pepper sweet and sour sauce

steps.text: Cut the pineapple and capsicum into chunks and toss the pork in egg and cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the pork in batches at 180C until crisp.
Simmer the pineapple and capsicum with vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, then thicken.
Toss the pork through and serve with the rice.

note: Beef chuck braised with carrots, onion and thyme, potatoes added

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the beef all over.
Add the onion, carrots, stock and thyme.
Cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes for the last hour.
Thicken the juices into gravy and serve family style.

note: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and garlic, roasted five hours, with flatbread

steps.text: Rub the lamb with cumin, crushed garlic, oil and salt.
Roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Stir crushed garlic through the yoghurt.
Pull the lamb apart and serve on a board with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt.

note: Beef braised in brown ale under puff pastry, with buttery mashed potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Filling a day ahead, top and bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.
Add the brown ale and water to cover and simmer until tender.
Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.

note: Beef and paprika goulash over buttered noodles with sour cream

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in oil
Cook the onions slowly
Stir in the paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock and beef
Cover and braise at 160C
Boil the noodles and toss with butter
Serve over the noodles with sour cream

note: Whole roast chicken with potatoes and thyme gravy, torn apart at the table

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter and salt and chop the potatoes into the tray.
Roast at 220C to start, then lower to 180C until cooked through.
Rest the chicken.
Make gravy with the pan juices, thyme and stock. Tear the chicken apart at the table.

film: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
note: Big beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce over spaghetti

dish.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Soak the bread in a little water and squeeze it out. Mix with the minces, half the parmesan and parsley.
Roll into big balls and brown all over.
Simmer in the tomatoes with basil.
Cook the spaghetti.
Pile over the pasta and top with the rest of the parmesan.

note: Braised chicken thighs with onion and garlic on long grain rice

steps.text: Brown the chicken thighs, then add the diced onion and the garlic cloves.
Pour in the chicken stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Cook the long grain rice, stir through the butter and the peas.
Plate in tidy single portions, like the airline trays.

note: Spatchcock chicken with garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, potatoes, grilled corn

dish.n: Lost Boys roast chicken, potatoes and corn

steps.text: Spatchcock the chicken and rub with crushed garlic, lemon zest and paprika. Chop the potatoes.
Roast at 220C with the potatoes in the tray.
Grill the corn cobs, turning until charred.
Pile it all in the middle and eat with your hands. Bangarang.

note: Beef mince and tomato lasagne layered with white sauce

steps.text: Brown the mince, add the passata and simmer.
Make a white sauce from the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C until golden and bubbling.

note: the corner store where the whole mess started

steps.text: Pound the steaks very thin.
Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Pour off most of the oil, stir the gravy flour into the pan, whisk in the milk and simmer thick with lots of black pepper.
Serve over the mashed potato.

note: Lamb neck simmered with pearl barley, carrots, leeks and rosemary

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the carrots and leeks.
Brown the lamb in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the barley, carrots, leeks, rosemary and water.
Simmer until the lamb falls from the bone.
Season and serve in deep bowls with crusty bread.

note: Lemon oregano chicken, roast red pepper, cucumber and feta over rice

dish.make_ahead: Chicken can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in lemon juice, oregano and oil while the oven heats.
Roast the capsicums at 220C until soft and blistered, then peel and slice into strips.
Cook the rice. Grill the chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Build bowls of rice with the chicken, capsicum, cucumber and feta and drizzle with tahini.

note: Pork sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and fried eggs

steps.text: Fry the sausages until browned.
Add the bacon, mushrooms and tomatoes to the pan.
Fry the eggs in the fat at the end.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Plate it all up.

note: Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, simmered in crushed tomato

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the mince with the parmesan, parsley, breadcrumbs and egg. Roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs on top.

note: Slow baked pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, with potato salad

dish.n: Fourth of July sticky pork ribs

steps.text: Rub the ribs with salt.
Bake covered at 150C.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Boil the potatoes, cool and dress with mayonnaise and spring onion.
Grill the corn and serve it all picnic style.

note: Marcus playing Mike, Mike playing Marcus, same order

dish.n: Mike and Marcus swap Cuban sandwich
dish.make_ahead: Marinate and roast the pork ahead

steps.text: Rub the pork with the orange and lime juice, crushed garlic, oregano, cumin and salt.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Put in a covered roasting dish with the water and roast at 160C until tender.
Rest the pork, then shred.
Split the rolls, spread with mustard and fill with pork, ham, Swiss cheese and pickles.
Butter the outsides and press in a hot sandwich press until crisp and the filling is piping hot.

note: Whole snapper stuffed with lemon, parsley and garlic

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Score the snapper three times on each side.
Stuff with lemon slices, parsley and sliced garlic, then rub with oil and salt.
Grill or bake at 220C until the flesh flakes at the thickest part.
Serve whole, heads on.

note: Seared sirloin and prawns with zucchini, egg fried rice, garlic butter

dish.n: Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice

steps.text: Cook the rice the day before.
Sear the sliced sirloin and the peeled prawns on a smoking plate with the garlic butter and soy.
Add sliced zucchini and onion.
Fry the rice with the eggs, butter and soy alongside, and serve everything together.

film: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001)
note: Honey mustard glazed drumsticks with roast potatoes and Yorkshire puddings

dish.n: Great Hall honey chicken and Yorkshires
dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Mix the honey and mustard and coat the drumsticks.
Toss the potatoes in the olive oil and roast with the chicken.
Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest.
Heat oil in muffin tins, pour in the batter and bake until puffed.
Cook the peas with the butter and warm the gravy.
Serve everything together.

note: Grilled fennel sausage, charred capsicum, onion and provolone in a roll

steps.text: Slice the red capsicums and the onions and cook in the oil over medium-high heat for 12 minutes until soft and charred.
Grill the Italian fennel sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Split the long rolls, toast, and lay a slice of provolone in.
Add a sausage, the capsicum and onion and a spoon of chopped hot giardiniera or pickled chillies.

note: Beef meatballs in tomato sauce over spaghetti, garlic butter baguette

steps.text: Roll the mince into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Split the baguette and spread with garlic butter.
Bake the bread until crisp.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Toss the sauce through the spaghetti with parmesan and serve with the bread.

note: Baked lobster tails in Dijon cream sauce with parmesan

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Halve the lobster tails and bake at 200C.
Boil the potatoes. Steam the beans.
Simmer the cream with Dijon until thick and stir in the parmesan.
Spoon over the lobster and grill until bubbling.
Toss the potatoes in butter and serve with the beans.

note: Spaghetti with shrimp, mussels and clams in garlic, white wine and chili

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the olive oil.
Add the wine, prawns, mussels and clams, cover and cook until the shells open, discarding any that stay shut.
Toss through the spaghetti and parsley.

note: fry the garlic, tomatoes and paste, brown the sausage and meatballs, a splash of wine, a little sugar

dish.make_ahead: Sauce is better made 1 day ahead, keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, a share of the pecorino and a pinch of salt. Form 12 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in olive oil with the sausages cut into chunks, then set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pot, add the garlic and tomato paste, then stir in the tomatoes and water.
Return the meat, cover partly and simmer gently, stirring and adding water if needed. Check the meatballs are cooked through.
Boil the rigatoni, toss with the sauce and serve with the meat and the rest of the pecorino.

note: Lamb shanks braised in red wine, tomato and rosemary until tender

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the shanks in the oil.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic.
Add the wine, tomatoes and rosemary, cover and braise at 160C.
Cook the polenta in salted water, stir in the butter.
Serve the shanks on top of the polenta.

note: Thin pizza with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms, cut in squares

steps.text: Stretch the dough thin on a floured tray.
Spread with sauce and scatter with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake on a hot steel or tray at the highest oven heat.
Slice and leave in a box on the bench.

note: Pan-fried crab cakes with Dijon, spring onion and crisp breadcrumbs

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, Dijon, sliced spring onion and breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Pan fry until golden on both sides.
Serve with lemon and a green salad.

note: Prawns and cherry tomatoes with garlic, chilli and chicken stock

steps.text: Peel the prawns, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the olive oil.
Add the prawns, tomatoes and stock and cook until the prawns turn pink.
Toss through the spaghetti with the parsley.

note: Chicken thighs and mushrooms simmered in apple cider and cream, with baguette

dish.n: Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream

steps.text: Season the chicken.
Brown in butter, 4 minutes a side, then set aside.
Soften the eschalots and mushrooms in the pan.
Pour in the cider and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.

note: Grilled sirloin in a cracked pepper cream sauce, thick chips

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Fry twice until crisp.
Grill the steaks to medium-rare and rest.
In the pan, toast the peppercorns, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve with the chips and a green salad.

note: Chicken thighs in red curry coconut sauce with lemongrass and lime leaves

dish.make_ahead: Curry up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken, the remaining coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.

note: Salmon cured 48 hours in salt, sugar and dill, with mustard sauce

dish.make_ahead: Needs 48 hours curing, keeps 4 days chilled

ingredients.item: caster sugar, 50g for the cure and the rest for the sauce

steps.text: Mix the salt, most of the sugar, chopped dill and white pepper and pack over the salmon.
Weight the salmon and cure in the fridge for 48 hours.
Wipe off the cure and slice thin.
Mix the Dijon, remaining sugar, vinegar, oil and dill for the sauce. Serve with rye bread.

note: Lemon, garlic and rosemary roast chicken with potatoes, carrots and gravy

steps.text: Stuff the chicken with half a lemon, garlic and rosemary
Cut the potatoes and carrots and put them in the tray
Roast at 200C
Rest the chicken
Make a quick gravy from the juices with flour and lemon

note: Bacon, sausage, eggs, black pudding, mushrooms, beans, tomato and buttered toast

steps.text: Grill the bacon and sausages.
Grill the halved tomatoes alongside and warm the beans.
Fry the black pudding and mushrooms, then the eggs.
Make buttered toast and serve everything together.

note: Thick split pea soup simmered with smoked ham hock, with crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Put the peas, hock, onion, carrots, celery and water in a large pot.
Simmer for 2 hours, stirring now and then.
Pick the ham off the bone and stir it back in. Season.
Serve with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.

note: Salmon brushed with miso, honey and soy and roasted, wild rice, charred broccolini

steps.text: Mix the miso, honey and soy and brush over the salmon.
Cook the rice until tender.
Roast the salmon at 220C for 8 minutes.
Char the broccolini in a hot pan and serve.

note: Garlic pepper beef rib roast with horseradish sauce

steps.text: Rub the beef with the garlic, pepper, oil and salt.
Roast at 220C, then lower to 180C for medium rare.
Rest the beef.
Parboil the potatoes, rough up, toss in duck fat and roast.
Simmer the pan juices with the wine and stock until reduced by half.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.

note: Garlic butter sirloin with oven fries and creamed spinach

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, then baste with the butter and the crushed garlic cloves.
Rest 5 minutes.
Serve with the oven fries and the spinach wilted with the cream.

note: order two, it's Monty's money

dish.make_ahead: Sauce best made just before serving

steps.text: Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon to a few spoonfuls.
Whisk with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in 200g of the warm clarified butter for the béarnaise.
Sear the steaks to medium rare, then rest.
Split the lobster tails and brush with garlic butter made from the remaining butter.
Grill the lobster until cooked through.
Plate the steak with lobster and sauce.

note: pepperoni and extra cheese, straight from the wall of fame

dish.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature for an hour. Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch the bases thin and spread with the sauce. Top with the mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until bubbling and charred in spots. Sprinkle with oregano and cut big.

note: slow paprika beef for the Carpathian painting

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a hot pan with oil.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft.
Stir in the sweet paprika, hot paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock and beef.
Cover and braise at 160C until the beef is very tender.
Boil the noodles and serve the goulash over them with the sour cream.

note: Crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs on buttered toast

dish.n: Bacon and scrambled eggs on toast
dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with salt and scramble slowly in butter until soft.
Toast and butter the bread.
Serve on tin plates with chives scattered over the eggs.

note: Pork shoulder roasted with crackling, apples and potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Salt the pork the night before

steps.text: Score the pork skin and rub with salt.
Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry out.
Roast at 160C for the first part of the cooking.
Chop the potatoes and halve the apples, toss with oil, and add to the pan.
Roast for the last hour.
Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles.
Rest the pork.
Steam the broccolini and serve on a long platter.

note: Navy beans baked 4 hours with ham hock and molasses, brown bread, coleslaw

dish.n: Ludlow baked beans with brown bread
dish.make_ahead: Soak overnight, bean dish keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight in cold water, then drain.
Put the beans, ham hock, onion, molasses, sugar, mustard and water in a covered dish.
Bake at 150C for 4 hours.
Serve with buttered brown bread and coleslaw.

note: Chicken and rice baked with saffron, paprika and capsicum

steps.text: Brown the chicken in an ovenproof pan.
Soften the onion and capsicum.
Add the rice, saffron, paprika and stock and nestle in the chicken.
Cover and bake at 180C.
Stir through the peas and olives.

note: Seafood stew of mussels, clams and fish in a tomato and white wine broth

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, cover and cook until they open.
Add the prawns and snapper and cook just until done. Serve with sourdough.

note: Crisp roast goose legs, goose fat potatoes, braised red cabbage with apple

dish.make_ahead: Salt a day ahead

steps.text: Salt the goose legs and leave overnight in the fridge.
Roast at 170C until crisp, pouring off the fat as it renders.
Halve the potatoes and roast in the goose fat at 200C.
Shred the cabbage and slice the apples, then braise together with the vinegar.
Braise gently until soft.

note: Grilled rump and sausages with molasses baked beans and creamy cabbage slaw

steps.text: Simmer the baked beans with the onion and molasses.
Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Grill the rump steaks and sausages over hot coals.
Slice the meat to share.

note: Red wine braised lamb shanks over buttery mashed potato

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Brown the lamb shanks in oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook.
Add wine, crushed tomatoes, stock, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and braise at 160C until the meat falls from the bone.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Reduce the sauce on the stove and spoon over the shanks.

note: Achiote citrus pork wrapped in banana leaf and roasted 4 hours, served in tortillas

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, pibil reheats well

steps.text: Blend the achiote paste with the orange and two limes' juice and rub over the pork.
Wrap the pork in banana leaves.
Roast covered at 150C until it falls apart.
Pickle the onion in lime juice while the pork cooks.
Shred the pork and serve in warm tortillas with the pickled onion.

note: Breaded minute steak shallow fried, with peppery cream gravy

steps.text: Pound the steaks thin and season the flour.
Dip in seasoned flour, then egg, then flour again.
Shallow fry in about 1cm oil until golden each side.
For the gravy, cook some flour in a little of the oil, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Season with lots of pepper.

note: the café's barbecue and its famous sauce

dish.make_ahead: Cook the pork up to 2 days ahead, reheat in its juices

steps.text: Rub the pork with the paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt.
Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until falling apart (included in cook time).
Simmer the tomato sauce with the vinegar until slightly thick, and pull the pork.
Dress the pork with the sauce. Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for slaw and serve with white bread. The secret's in the sauce.

note: Glazed salmon, sushi rice, pickled ginger and rice vinegar cucumber

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Cook the sushi rice.
Grill the salmon, brushing with the glaze until sticky.
Soft boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Slice the cucumber thinly and dress in rice vinegar.
Pack boxes with rice, salmon, pickled ginger, cucumber and egg.

note: Grilled boerewors sausage in rolls with tomato chili relish

steps.text: Slice the onions, chop the tomatoes and chilli.
Simmer with the sugar into a relish.
Grill the boerewors over coals or a hot grill, turning once.
Cut the boerewors and serve in rolls with relish.

note: Chicken thighs and mushrooms in a white wine, cream and tarragon sauce

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, slice the mushrooms and chop the tarragon.
Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and simmer.
Stir in the cream and tarragon.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and steam the beans.

note: Roast chicken with roast potatoes and gravy, steamed vegetables

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter, lemon and thyme.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then at 180C for 50 minutes with the potatoes.
Rest the chicken and make gravy from the pan juices and stock.
Steam the beans and serve.

note: the sharp dresser

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine 4 to 12 hours

steps.text: Pat the steaks dry, season with salt and refrigerate uncovered to dry-brine.
Heat a heavy pan with oil until hot and sear the steaks hard on both sides, in batches.
Lower the heat, add the butter, thyme and crushed garlic and baste. Take out at 54C in the centre for medium rare.
Rest the steaks, slice and spoon over the pan butter.

note: Chicken thighs marinated in homemade chilli peri peri sauce and grilled

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, oil and salt into a peri peri sauce.
Marinate the chicken in the sauce.
Grill until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Serve together.

note: Chuck steak, carrot, mushroom and barley stew

dish.n: Winston the ogre's beef and barley stew
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the beef, onion, carrots and mushrooms and toss the beef in flour.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onion, carrots, mushrooms and garlic and cook.
Add tomato paste, stock, barley and bay leaves.
Simmer covered until the beef is tender.
Mash the butter with horseradish cream.
Serve with the horseradish butter and a crusty loaf.
